description: This file defines the PhysicalView class responsible for visualizing device hierarchies in a GTK-based GUI, including layout calculations and event handling.

classes.name: PhysicalView
classes.description: Class responsible for rendering a physical device hierarchy visualization using GTK widgets, managing layout, event handling, and dynamic resizing.

methods.name: __init__
methods.description: Initializes the PhysicalView with a reference to the GUI controller, sets up GTK layout containers, and initializes internal state.

methods.name: visualize_parents
methods.description: Begins visualization of a device list hierarchy, clearing previous layout and starting recursive visualization.

methods.name: _visualization_loop
methods.description: Recursively traverses device hierarchy to create GTK widgets representing devices and their relationships.

methods.name: _compute_rect_widths
methods.description: Calculates widths for device rectangles based on available view width and device sizes.

methods.name: _allocate_remaining_space
methods.description: Distributes remaining width among device rectangles proportionally based on device size.

methods.name: _get_total_device_size
methods.description: Sums the sizes of all devices at a given hierarchy level.

methods.name: _clear
methods.description: Removes all existing device rectangles and boxes from the layout.

methods.name: _new_rectangle
methods.description: Creates a new Rectangle widget for a device with specified type and size.

methods.name: _get_child_position
methods.description: Determines if a child device is first, last, or an inner node among its siblings.

methods.name: _on_button_press
methods.description: Handles double-click events on device rectangles to switch device views if applicable.
